name: Demo · PII / PCI Detector
headline: Span-level PII / PCI detector for redaction & guardrails
description: Pre-loaded with 60 synthetic chat / log / form snippets and a 25-row gold set. Each row's gold answer is a JSON object listing every PII / PCI span found in the text — type, start offset, end offset, and the raw value — so the trained model can plug into LlamaFirewall or any redaction pipeline that needs structured entity output. Covers email, phone, SSN, credit card, person_name, street_address, date_of_birth, ip_address, api_key, bank_account.
suggested_brief: Train a span-level PII / PCI detector that takes a snippet of text and emits a JSON object {"entities": [{type, start, end, text}, ...]} naming every sensitive value it finds. Targets covered: email, phone, SSN, credit card, person_name, street_address, date_of_birth, ip_address, api_key, bank_account. Output must be valid JSON so it can drop into a LlamaFirewall scanner or any redaction pipeline. Optimize for recall — false negatives leak PII; false positives are cheaper to dismiss.
